questionText:
Match the following:

FieldLength in bits
P. UDP Header's Port NumberI. 48
Q. Ethernet MAC AddressII. 8
R. IPv6 Next HeaderIII. 32
S. TCP Header's Sequence NumberIV. 16
explanation:
Field lengths in networking protocols:

• P. UDP Header's Port Number: Both source and destination port numbers in a UDP header are $16$ bits long (matches IV).
• Q. Ethernet MAC Address: An Ethernet MAC address is $6$ bytes or $48$ bits long (matches I).
• R. IPv6 Next Header: The Next Header field in IPv6 is $1$ byte or $8$ bits long (matches II).
• S. TCP Header's Sequence Number: The sequence number field in a TCP header is $32$ bits long (matches III).

Thus, the correct matching sequence is P-IV, Q-I, R-II, S-III.
